title: Number Operating (Hard Version)
statement: The task sums f(n) over [l, r], r ≤ 10^18, with no bound on r - l; f(n) counts the fewest '+2^k' (k = current addition streak) or '-1' moves reaching n. A run of a additions adds 2^a - 1, so an optimal path climbs to a peak ≥ n then decrements, runs chosen greedily as largest Mersenne numbers; self-similar power-of-two blocks make the range sum a digit DP.
